scientific_status: exploratory because the six untuned 70M checkpoints were already inspected under K009
kernel: unchanged K001 fused signed-exact warp compaction
site_policy: topology-active supported linear sites only: a, m, h, z
timing: 16 fixed development inputs, 3 paired eager passes, 48 samples per mode
qualification: unchanged 16-block calibration gates plus every one of the 338 complete validation blocks; excluded tail 1,444 tokens

selection_rule.A1-H: maximize paired geometric-mean speedup on 70m/a1h among qualified masks
selection_rule.A4-OL1: require both kappa=0 and kappa=0.5 development checkpoints to qualify, then maximize their geometric-mean speedup
selection_rule.A7-OL1: require both kappa=0 and kappa=0.5 development checkpoints to qualify, then maximize their geometric-mean speedup
selection_rule.tie_break: within 0.005 of the best score, choose fewer adapted layers, then lexical mask id
selection_rule.A0: native fallback; no sparse kernel is labeled for the effectively dense control

interpretation: One static layer mask is selected per topology and reused across kappas. No runtime-density or checkpoint-identity dispatch is permitted. Untuned results are not rerun or used as confirmation.
